c1b58c653f09.en: How people in Vraki have fun. Sports include Homeegg, a Forway team sport played in the air with the help of nari gels, plus Fast Fish, Fast Bird, fishing contests, Gandew and Forway duels, and egua races. Games include Territory Snipping, Stealball and Minari. For pastimes there's music, tavern-hopping, reading, theater and tourism.
c1b58c653f09.t: Como as pessoas de Vraki se divertem. Os esportes incluem o Homeegg, um esporte coletivo de Forway jogado no ar com a ajuda de nari gels, além do Fast Fish, do Fast Bird, de competições de pesca, dos duelos de Gandew e de Forway e das corridas de egua. Os jogos incluem Territory Snipping, Stealball e Minari. Entre os passatempos, há música, ir de taverna em taverna, leitura, teatro e turismo.
